name: @w6w-apps/google-sheets
description: Read and write Google Sheets: manage spreadsheets, sheets, rows and cells.

w6w.longDescription:
Google Sheets reads and writes spreadsheet data from a workflow — appending new rows, updating existing ranges, or using an append-or-update action that decides between the two based on a key column, which is the pattern most sync workflows actually need rather than always inserting a new row.

Sheet and spreadsheet structure is manageable too: sheets can be created, listed, cleared and deleted, columns and rows can be deleted individually, and whole spreadsheets can be created and deleted, so a workflow can provision or tear down structure as part of its own process rather than assuming it already exists.

A fit for logging workflow output into a spreadsheet as it runs, syncing a sheet with data from another system, or reading a range back to drive a later step's logic.
